'''Strike Base XR-484''' was the command base of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] on the planet [[Ossus/Legends|Ossus]] during the [[Invasion of Ossus]].<ref name="Codex" />

==Description==
Strike Base XR-484 acted as the main staging point for all Imperial operations on the planet Ossus during the [[Invasion of Ossus]] and was constructed within a field of [[Starship/Legends|starship]] wreckage on the recommendation of the [[Scout/Legends|scouts]] who first reconnoitered the planet and correctly assessed that the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] were more interested in exploring ancient structures than old crashed ships. This ensured that the Imperial base could have been established without drawing enemy attention.<ref name="Codex" />

[[File:XR-484.png|thumb|right|220px|The Nest]]
The members of the [[Raven Squad]] consistently referred to the base as "the Nest", a term that [[Darth Malora]] pointedly refused to use during the [[Invasion of Ossus]].<ref name="Codex" />

==History==
The majority of the ship wreckage around XR-484 was the result of crashes caused by the [[Cron Supernova/Legends|Cron Supernova]] [[3996 BBY|centuries ago]]. However, the remains of newer vessels were also present at the time of the [[third Galactic War]]. This lead to suggestions that atmospheric or gravitational conditions somehow resulted in a higher-than-average distribution of crashed ships in this specific area.<ref name="Codex" />
